subject: general
question: Which of the following sports events was hosted by India from 20 January 2022 in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai and Pune?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AFC Women's Asian Cup**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2022, **Mumbai and Pune will host the AFC Women's Asian Cup.**
 
• All of the matches of the **AFC Women's Asian Cup 2022 **were played in the **D.Y. Patil Stadium in Navi Mumbai, the Mumbai Football Arena in Andheri, and the Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex in Balewadi, Pune.**
 
• It is planned to hold the competition from January 20 to February 6, 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIFA Women's World Cup:-**

 
 
• ​The **FIFA Women's World Cup** is an **international association football championship** where the senior women's national teams of the **FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association)**, the sport's global governing body, participate.
 
 
 
• **Asian Champions Trophy**:-
 
 
• ​The **Asian Hockey Federation** hosts the **Men's Asian Champions Trophy** every year (since 2011). In a round-robin style, it comprises the best six field hockey squads from Asia from that season. The two most successful teams in the history of this competition are India and Pakistan.
 
 
 
• **Asian Track & Para-Cycling Championships**:-
 
 
• ​The** Asian Cycling Championship (Road & Track)** includes the** Asian Track Cycling Championships (ATCC)**, which is only for Asian cyclists who have been chosen by their national governing bodies and other **Asian Cycling Confederation **member countries.
 
• Track cycling has an annual continental championship. Cycling contests for the road and the track are now held separately as of 2017.
